sessionHeaderBug: ConversationRun only propagated the conversation ID for openai-codex-responses; opencode/opencode-go requests therefore lacked x-opencode-session in interactive runs. Fixed to propagate the existing conversation ID for those providers, with a ConversationRun regression.

corrections.description: Live OpenCode Go exposed MissingSessionID because ConversationRun propagated its conversation ID only for openai-codex-responses. OpenCode providers now receive the existing session ID; deterministic ConversationRun regressions cover all three OpenCode protocol families.

Google thought signatures now carry actual provider affinity (OpenCode vs Google) with fail-first both-direction regression; opencode/opencode-go are credential siblings in models.json validation; pinned generated catalogue sources and verifier are committed for reproducible provenance.

googleSignatureAffinity.defect: Signature provider was only google/google-vertex, allowing opaque signatures to replay across official Google and OpenCode endpoints for identical model IDs.
googleSignatureAffinity.fix: GoogleGenAiChatClient records and compares the actual provider ID.

providerOverrides.behaviour: opencode and opencode-go are siblings sharing OPENCODE_API_KEY; a same-endpoint models.json override of opencode-go is accepted.
